global_summary: AES-128 inverse cipher (decryption) with key expansion and iterative round transformations
primary clock: clk, reset: rst, Top-level active-high reset (rst). Key expansion and RCON are reset via kld signal.
All modules sharing a clock use the same clk domain
Key expansion output words (wo_0..wo_3) feed the top module's key buffer (kb)
Round constant from aes_rcon is used inside aes_key_expand_128
aes_inv_sbox instances are purely combinational, placed in top module
aes_sbox instances are purely combinational, used exclusively in key expansion
Reverse-order key schedule: kb[10] = initial round key, kb[0] = last round key
Round counter selects round key: kb[dcnt]
Load key into aes_key_expand_128 via kld, then buffer expanded keys in reverse order
Perform initial AddRoundKey on data load, then iterate 10 rounds
Final round skips InvMixColumns; result latched into text_out
generation order: aes_inv_sbox, aes_sbox, aes_rcon, aes_key_expand_128, aes_inv_cipher_top
